      - name: Build executable
        shell: cmd
        run: |
          pyinstaller --onefile --clean --icon icons/app_icon.ico batch_rename.py

      - name: List dist contents (debug)
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          if (Test-Path dist) {
            Get-ChildItem -Recurse dist | Select-Object FullName, Length | Format-Table -AutoSize
          } else {
            Write-Output "dist directory not found"
          }

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/**/*.exe
